$runtimeInjectedCells.description: Runtime-injected cells per row envelope. `rowAssignments[row]` lists the envelope sets that auto-merge cells onto that row type at runtime (via Loopable_Row + Action_Row_Definition + Row_Builder::build_shape()). These cells are valid on the row type but are NOT present in `widgets[*].rows[<row>].props` — they're injected at runtime, not declared per-row. Reviewers should consult this block before flagging row-level _vx_loop / _vx_visibility / _ef_loop_query / action-suite props as phantoms. See plugins/custom/elementor-framework/schemas/parts/rows/_envelope-loop.schema.json for the source of truth.

layout.description: Choose the layout per screen size. Tablet/mobile default to "Inherit" in the panel, but an inherited (empty) breakpoint resolves to this Part's default layout — it does NOT copy the desktop layout down. So a horizontal card collapses to vertical on tablet/mobile unless that breakpoint is set explicitly (responsiveInherit=false).
